labels.expectedValue: Yes, in three circumstances: (1) Damage/destruction — Tenant may terminate if Landlord determines the Building/Premises can't be restored within the earlier of 270 days or the Term's expiration; Landlord may terminate on the same 270-day threshold, on an uninsured casualty (60 days' notice), if a mortgagee requires the insurance proceeds (15 days' notice), or on excessive damage during the Term's last 12 months. (2) Eminent domain — either party may terminate if a taking substantially interferes with its use of the Premises/Building/Project.
